title: KMS Environment Readiness Checker

transitions.note: Created after operational audit found the generic env checker did not cover the prepared Stage 3 KMS runtime contract.
Add a dedicated kms mode requiring region, role ARN and KMS key id while rejecting static AWS credentials. Keep basic/full CI behavior unchanged until the live AWS gate is enabled.

notes: No AWS, Vercel env, database, OpenRouter or paid-traffic mutation. Checker-only readiness hardening.
